messages.subject: Rather ugly Latent Growth Model
parts:
Good morning,

I am writing syntax to produce a growth model. The models work fine, but the diagrams are a mess. The syntax for my diagram, and an example diagram, are attached:

semPaths(se.fit, what='est', edge.color = "black", fade = FALSE, layout = "tree2")
title("SE LGM", line=1)

I was wondering if anyone could make any suggestions to make this more aesthetically pleasing? In particular I'm trying to stop the path widths being determined by their coefficient (e.g. that chunky dashed line on the right), and stop any coefficients overlapping each other. Any suggestions on how to rectify these/generally make the diagram better would be much appreciated. 

Regards,

Dave
